thread:
Maria Chen: Quick check-in on Helix dedicated pool utilization this week — noticed a late-Tue spike during the AcroHealth onboarding cohort. Can we get a quick pulse on GPU hours, saturation, and queue depth?

Jon Patel: saw the alert. AcroHealth onboarding + canary traffic overlapped, caused a backlog. not a full outage but latency spiked.

CapacityBot: automated capacity snapshot:
```
saturation_avg: 78%
saturation_peak: 95% (2026-03-17T20:14Z)
avg_queue_depth: 12
max_queue_depth: 47
gpu_hours_72h: 1250
projected_7d: 8900
top_tenant: AcroHealth (42% of spike minutes)
```

Liam O'Rourke: looking at runtime telemetry now — the KV cache warm-up for that cohort was unusually cold (lots of long contexts), so batching didn't hit ideal thresholds. that + default autoscale cooldown caused queue to grow.

Maria Chen: thanks Liam. is there a short mitigation we can enable before next onboarding wave? Grace, FYI re: renewal risk if they see more latency.

Grace Kim: on it — I sent AcroHealth a note offering a staggered onboarding window. they said they'd prefer no delays, so we'd need internal fixes. flagging potential renewal friction.

Liam O'Rourke: short fixes: reduce autoscale cooldown from 300s -> 120s for Helix-dedicated, enable burst +2 GPUs for 4 hours around onboards, and pre-warm KV cache by replaying 5 recent sessions per tenant.

Jon Patel: sounds good. any cost impact estimate for burst +2 GPUs? need to clear with finance if we modify reserved capacity.

Liam O'Rourke: rough math: +2 x p4d for 4h = ~2 GPU-hours * 4h * rate -> roughly adds 8 GPU-hours per burst window (~$X depending on commit). projected weekly delta if we do 3 waves: ~24 GPU-hours.

Sasha Rivera: prioritization: avoid product-visible latency first (protect renewal). approve short-term burst and cooldown change. ops/infra to implement; CS to communicate with customer and set expectation.

Maria Chen: action items:
- @Liam O'Rourke: apply autoscale cooldown change + enable burst policy for next 48h window.
- @Jon Patel: confirm cost delta with finance and note on account renewal risk.
- @Grace Kim: offer stagger option + run a post-onboard survey to capture perf feedback.
- @CapacityBot: run hourly snapshots and ping this thread if queue_depth > 20 for 6 consecutive mins.

Jon Patel: I'll ping finance now and update thread. :eyes:

Liam O'Rourke: I'll apply the cooldown change in stage and roll to prod after 30m verification. posting config diff in eng-ops.

CapacityBot: ack — hourly snapshots enabled for Helix-dedicated. will alert on sustained queue.

Grace Kim: messaging draft to AcroHealth ready, will include compensation offer if they experience >2s p95 for >1h during onboarding.

Maria Chen: great. let's reconvene Thu morning same thread to verify metrics after the fix. thanks all. :thumbsup:
